title: Exact Class-II smart-path cancellation and noncentral frozen-shell control
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 finite-cutoff production Gaussian, fixed positive rho floor, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and common real-even A7 regulators, the independent-to-self-coupled Gaussian smart path admits an exact conditional determinant and Gaussian-IBP derivative in which every apparent trace-class term cancels into Schatten-2 pairings, centered Hilbert-Schmidt quadratics, and a common-even divergence term. For every past-measurable PSD frozen shell background and arbitrary past-measurable derivative source, the exact noncentral determinant obeys the same cutoff-uniform Hilbert-Schmidt ceiling; its q^-4 dyadic shell cost gains 2^-j and is summable.
scope: CLOSED@EXACT-INTERPOLATION-AND-NONCENTRAL-FROZEN-SHELL on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, eta_shell=0, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the declared common real-even scalar regulator class. The theorem closes finite-cutoff interpolation algebra, base-law Schatten structure, arbitrary-source frozen-shell integration, dyadic frozen costs, and deterministic/independent shifts. It excludes uniform tilted-law commutator control and the self-coupled Gibbs measure.
